items.desc: The Virginia Department of Social Services (VDSS) seeks proposals to continue the Virginia Whole Family (Two Generation) Pilot Project. This RFP is intended to comply with the competitive proposal requirements applicable to procurement of grant administration and construction management services under federal grant rules and HUD CPF monitoring expectations.

Project Background
The EDI CPF program is administered by the US Department of Housing and Urban Development and funded through directed Congressional appropriation.
